                    ### Question

Physical examination shows bilateral temporal visual field loss. An MRI of the head shows a small calcified suprasellar mass. The patient undergoes surgery with complete removal of the mass. Pathological examination of the specimen shows a lobular tumor composed of cysts filled with oily, brownish-yellow fluid. This mass is most likely derived from which of the following structures?

                    ### Options

opb. Arachnoid cells
opc. Astroglial cells
opd. Lactotroph cells
ope. Ventricular ependyma
